text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The final part—running. Our anchors are
on their last few laps! In the
lead is Team
Bakushin's Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Bakushin O gave me the lead.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(She took on the exhausting cycling leg.
Not only that, she chose the
longest route,
the one everyone said she's least suited
to, and she finished it!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I...
I won't give up either! I believe I can
do it!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Kita picked up her pace! If she widens the
gap any farther, she might
just outpace
everyone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, this drama's climax is yet to come.
Top
Road will surely put on a
dazzling
performance in the last scene!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan won't shake us off that easy. I
know Bright will get a grip on
her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(According to Matikanetannhauser,
Kitasan has high endurance and a sharp
turn of foot.
It'll be tough if she gets any
farther ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(But I have to stay in control of my own
pace. Which means...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Bright sped up! It's still early for me,
but I
can't get left behind!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Narita Top Road have
picked up the pace! They're
gradually
closing the gap!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (They're... getting closer!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (I will catch up! I will break away!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(They believe in me—Opera O, Doto, and
Ayabe. I'll show them
they're right!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (This is for Big Sister Ryan!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAAH!
DAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Narita Top Road are
closing in on Kitasan Black!
Can she hold
out?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Got to keep my lead! Keep running!
Faster, until the end!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I'm gonna finish this!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black accelerates again!
Will it be
enough?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black crosses the finish line!
She's
won it! Kitasan Black wins!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Academy Team Triathlon goes
to Team Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright, you came so close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I suppose I'll bring home glory next
time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? You seem kind of happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am. Until I took part in this contest,
I felt
a little inferior compared
to the others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But...
it was a really close race! A little bit
longer, and I think I could
have done it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Through our training and friendly
rivalry, I
grew even stronger than I
could've
imagined!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like it was worth it,
then. I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It most certainly was! Special Week,
Matikanetannhauser... Thank you
very
much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
During practice and the real contest, I
couldn't have done it without
you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No way! I haven't done anything for you to
thank me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You gave us an awesome head start, Spe.
And Tannhauser, your drink
gave me a
great energy boost!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa! So it worked! Being on this team
has given me some courage
and
confidence!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It was really fun getting to train and
compete with this team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! On that note,
I'd like to invite you
to a reception at the
Mejiro estate. We'll
prepare an all-you-can-eat banquet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Hi. I didn't make it in time...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-i-it's all my fault,
sorryyyyy! Even though
Ayabe came in first, I had
to go and mess
it all up with my clumsiness!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! It wasn't your fault, Doto! I
should've worded that better. Sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We made a scene like no
other! And we have the special
award to
prove it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We put on a fantastic intermedio show!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With any luck, the main story will be even
more enthralling!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Once was more than enough.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Only the goddesses of fate
know what's in store for us!
Now, I'll see
you later. Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, w-w-wait, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to be worthy of you all—as your
friend and rival, now and
forever!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Above anyone else, I want to win against
you all!)

text_block_list.name: Polite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, Satono—congratulations on your
win! You're amazing for
winning against
the older students!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. See, you don't know until you try!

text_block_list.name: Pessimistic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You two... are truly amazing! W-watching
you... brought a tear to my
eye!

text_block_list.name: Polite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You really inspired me! I'm going to push
myself to try new things too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! You did it, Kitasan!
That was a wicked upset you
pulled out
there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You ran a fantastic race! What a
triumphant show of spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I was so absorbed in the
moment, I'm not even sure how I
ran
myself...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yep, leave it to good ol' passion to turn
the tables! All right, let's toss
you up in
the air! You over there, join us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. They did a number on you, huh? But
it's sweet of them to
celebrate with us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It reminded me of something—how I
felt the first time I saw
Teio race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Her running inspired me. It made me want
to run just like her!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, has today brought you one step closer
to your goal?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to our older teammates!
They've given me so much
courage!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I want to inspire others with my
own strength. Just like Teio, my dad, and
our teammates, I want to make everyone
smile with my running!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And I want to run with everyone again too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Does that include me?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course it does! Let's keep running
together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"You know, Mom, Tracen Academy is a
wonderful place."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"There are soooo many athletes I'd love to
race against here! Achieving my goal won't
be easy, but that's also what makes it

exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let myself fall behind.
Because I'm
going to become the best
Umamusume in
Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's it! I'm gonna do this!
